    36	/-- The state-dependent distance of two square-summable families is at most
    37	`4` on a unit vector, under a uniform distribution. -/
    38	theorem opFamilyDistSq_uniform_le_four {X α ι : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
    39	    [Nonempty X] [Fintype α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    40	    (A B : X → α → Op ι) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1)
    41	    (hA : ∀ x, ∑ a, (A x a)ᴴ * A x a ≤ 1) (hB : ∀ x, ∑ a, (B x a)ᴴ * B x a ≤ 1) :
    42	    opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution X) A B ψ ≤ 4 := by
    43	  unfold opFamilyDistSq
    44	  calc avgOver (uniformDistribution X) (fun x =>
    45	        ∑ a, ‖applyOperatorToState (A x a - B x a) ψ‖ ^ 2)
    46	      ≤ avgOver (uniformDistribution X) (fun _ => (4 : ℝ)) := by
    47	        exact avgOver_mono _ _ _ fun x =>
    48	          sum_norm_sub_apply_sq_le_four (A x) (B x) ψ hψ (hA x) (hB x)
    49	    _ = 4 := avgOver_uniform_const _
    50	
    51	/-- The products `A_a B_b` of the effects of two projective measurements on a
    52	common space are square-summable to the identity. -/
    53	theorem sum_mul_conjTranspose_mul_self_eq_one {α β ι : Type*} [Fintype α]
    54	    [Fintype β] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    55	    (A : Measurement α ι) (B : Measurement β ι)
    56	    (hA : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective A)
    57	    (hB : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective B) :
    58	    ∑ ab : α × β, (A.effect ab.1 * B.effect ab.2)ᴴ * (A.effect ab.1 * B.effect ab.2) =
    59	      1 := by
    60	  have hpt : ∀ (a : α) (b : β),
    61	      (A.effect a * B.effect b)ᴴ * (A.effect a * B.effect b) =
    62	        B.effect b * A.effect a * B.effect b := by
    63	    intro a b
    64	    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, (hA a).isSelfAdjoint.isHermitian.eq,
    65	      (hB b).isSelfAdjoint.isHermitian.eq, Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ (A.effect a * B.effect b),
    66	      ← Matrix.mul_assoc (A.effect a) (A.effect a), (hA a).isIdempotentElem.eq,
    67	      ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
    68	  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type_right]
    69	  calc ∑ b : β, ∑ a : α, (A.effect a * B.effect b)ᴴ * (A.effect a * B.effect b)
    70	      = ∑ b : β, B.effect b * (∑ a : α, A.effect a) * B.effect b := by
    71	        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
    72	        rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
    73	        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => hpt a b
    74	    _ = 1 := by
    75	        simp_rw [A.sum_eq_one, mul_one]
    76	        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => (hB b).isIdempotentElem.eq]
    77	        exact B.sum_eq_one
    78	
    79	/-- The products `B_b A_a` of the effects of two projective measurements on a
    80	common space, indexed by the pair `(a, b)`, are square-summable to the
    81	identity. -/
    82	theorem sum_mul_conjTranspose_mul_self_eq_one' {α β ι : Type*} [Fintype α]
    83	    [Fintype β] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    84	    (A : Measurement α ι) (B : Measurement β ι)
    85	    (hA : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective A)
    86	    (hB : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective B) :
    87	    ∑ ab : α × β, (B.effect ab.2 * A.effect ab.1)ᴴ * (B.effect ab.2 * A.effect ab.1) =
    88	      1 := by
    89	  have hpt : ∀ (a : α) (b : β),
    90	      (B.effect b * A.effect a)ᴴ * (B.effect b * A.effect a) =
    91	        A.effect a * B.effect b * A.effect a := by
    92	    intro a b
    93	    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, (hA a).isSelfAdjoint.isHermitian.eq,
    94	      (hB b).isSelfAdjoint.isHermitian.eq, Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ (B.effect b * A.effect a),
    95	      ← Matrix.mul_assoc (B.effect b) (B.effect b), (hB b).isIdempotentElem.eq,
    96	      ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
    97	  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    98	  calc ∑ a : α, ∑ b : β, (B.effect b * A.effect a)ᴴ * (B.effect b * A.effect a)
    99	      = ∑ a : α, A.effect a * (∑ b : β, B.effect b) * A.effect a := by
   100	        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
   101	        rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
   102	        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => hpt a b
   103	    _ = 1 := by
   104	        simp_rw [B.sum_eq_one, mul_one]
   105	        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => (hA a).isIdempotentElem.eq]
   106	        exact A.sum_eq_one

   114	/-- The three closeness conclusions of `lem:qld-4-10` for a pair of projective
   115	families close to the placed sandwiches: with `η` the closeness of `Q` to `R`
   116	on every placement, `C₁ √ε` the closeness of `R` to the ordered product,
   117	`C₂ √ε` the commutation error, and `C₃ ε` the cross-placement consistency of
   118	the ordered products, the distances from `Q` on one placement to the two
   119	ordered products and to `Q` on the opposite placement are bounded by explicit
   120	combinations.  Paper
   121	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:838-881`. -/
   122	theorem chain_bounds (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
   123	    (Q : (side : PlayerSide) → PointPair P →
   124	      Measurement (PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P) (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side))
   125	    (η C₁ C₂ C₃ : ℝ)
   126	    (hQR : ∀ p : Placement, opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution (PointPair P))
   127	      (fun xz (ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P) =>
   128	        S.place p ((Q p.side xz).effect ab))
   129	      (fun xz ab => S.place p ((S.sandwichPoint p.side xz.1 xz.2).effect ab))
   130	      S.psiHat ≤ η)
   131	    (h₁ : ∀ p : Placement, opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution (PointPair P))
   132	      (fun xz (ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P) =>
   133	        S.place p ((S.sandwichPoint p.side xz.1 xz.2).effect ab))
   134	      (fun xz ab => S.place p
   135	        ((S.pointMeasExp p.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2 *
   136	          (S.pointMeasExp p.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1))
   137	      S.psiHat ≤ C₁ * Real.sqrt ε)
   138	    (h₂ : ∀ p : Placement, opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution (PointPair P))
   139	      (fun xz (ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P) => S.place p
   140	        ((S.pointMeasExp p.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1 *
   141	          (S.pointMeasExp p.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2))
   142	      (fun xz ab => S.place p
   143	        ((S.pointMeasExp p.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2 *
   144	          (S.pointMeasExp p.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1))
   145	      S.psiHat ≤ C₂ * Real.sqrt ε)
   146	    (h₃ : ∀ p₁ p₂ : Placement, p₁.IsOpposite p₂ →
   147	      opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution (PointPair P))
   148	        (fun xz (ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P) => S.place p₁
   149	          ((S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2 *
   150	            (S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1))
   151	        (fun xz ab => S.place p₂
   152	          ((S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1 *
   153	            (S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2))
   154	        S.psiHat ≤ C₃ * ε)
   155	    (p₁ p₂ : Placement) (hopp : p₁.IsOpposite p₂) :
   156	    opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution (PointPair P))
   157	        (fun xz (ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P) =>
   158	          S.place p₁ ((Q p₁.side xz).effect ab))
   159	        (fun xz ab => S.place p₂
   160	          ((S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1 *
   161	            (S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2))
   162	        S.psiHat ≤ 2 * η + 4 * (C₁ * Real.sqrt ε) + 4 * (C₃ * ε) ∧
   163	      opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution (PointPair P))
   164	        (fun xz (ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P) =>
   165	          S.place p₁ ((Q p₁.side xz).effect ab))
   166	        (fun xz ab => S.place p₂
   167	          ((S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2 *
   168	            (S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1))
   169	        S.psiHat ≤ 4 * η + 8 * (C₁ * Real.sqrt ε) + 8 * (C₃ * ε) +
   170	          2 * (C₂ * Real.sqrt ε) ∧
   171	      opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution (PointPair P))
   172	        (fun xz (ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P) =>
   173	          S.place p₁ ((Q p₁.side xz).effect ab))
   174	        (fun xz ab => S.place p₂ ((Q p₂.side xz).effect ab))
   175	        S.psiHat ≤ 12 * η + 20 * (C₁ * Real.sqrt ε) + 16 * (C₃ * ε) +
   176	          4 * (C₂ * Real.sqrt ε) := by
   177	  -- `R_1 ≈ M^X M^Z` on the opposite placement
   178	  have hRXZ := opFamilyDistSq_le_of_le_of_le (uniformDistribution (PointPair P))
   179	    _ _ _ S.psiHat _ _ (h₁ p₁) (h₃ p₁ p₂ hopp)
   180	  -- `Q_1 ≈ M^X M^Z` on the opposite placement
   181	  have hQXZ := opFamilyDistSq_le_of_le_of_le (uniformDistribution (PointPair P))
   182	    _ _ _ S.psiHat _ _ (hQR p₁) hRXZ
   183	  -- `Q_1 ≈ M^Z M^X` on the opposite placement
   184	  have hQZX := opFamilyDistSq_le_of_le_of_le (uniformDistribution (PointPair P))
   185	    _ _ _ S.psiHat _ _ hQXZ (h₂ p₂)
   186	  -- `M^Z M^X ≈ Q_2` on the opposite placement
   187	  have hZXQ : opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution (PointPair P))
   188	      (fun xz (ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P) => S.place p₂
   189	        ((S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2 *
   190	          (S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1))
   191	      (fun xz ab => S.place p₂ ((Q p₂.side xz).effect ab))
   192	      S.psiHat ≤ 2 * η + 2 * (C₁ * Real.sqrt ε) := by
   193	    rw [opFamilyDistSq_symm]
   194	    exact opFamilyDistSq_le_of_le_of_le (uniformDistribution (PointPair P))
   195	      _ _ _ S.psiHat _ _ (hQR p₂) (h₁ p₂)
   196	  have hQQ := opFamilyDistSq_le_of_le_of_le (uniformDistribution (PointPair P))
   197	    _ _ _ S.psiHat _ _ hQZX hZXQ
   198	  refine ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩
   199

   202	/-! ## Collapsing the error terms into one power -/
   203	
   204	/-- For `0 ≤ ε ≤ 1`, the error terms `ε`, `√ε`, and `(C₀ (ε + √ε))^{1/4}`
   205	with `C₀ ≥ 1` are all bounded by multiples of `ε^{1/8}`. -/
   206	theorem error_terms_le_rpow_eighth {ε C₀ : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
   207	    (hC₀ : 1 ≤ C₀) :
   208	    ε ≤ Real.rpow ε (1 / 8 : ℝ) ∧ Real.sqrt ε ≤ Real.rpow ε (1 / 8 : ℝ) ∧
   209	      Real.rpow (C₀ * (ε + Real.sqrt ε)) (1 / 4 : ℝ) ≤
   210	        2 * C₀ * Real.rpow ε (1 / 8 : ℝ) := by
   211	  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hε with h0 | hpos
   212	  · subst h0
   213	    have h8 : Real.rpow (0 : ℝ) (1 / 8 : ℝ) = 0 := Real.zero_rpow (by norm_num)
   214	    have h4 : Real.rpow (C₀ * (0 + Real.sqrt 0)) (1 / 4 : ℝ) = 0 := by
   215	      rw [Real.sqrt_zero, add_zero, mul_zero]
   216	      exact Real.zero_rpow (by norm_num)
   217	    rw [h8, h4, Real.sqrt_zero]
   218	    refine ⟨le_rfl, le_rfl, ?_⟩
   219	    positivity
   220	  · have hsqrt : Real.sqrt ε = Real.rpow ε (1 / 2 : ℝ) := Real.sqrt_eq_rpow ε
   221	    have hε1' : Real.rpow ε 1 = ε := Real.rpow_one ε
   222	    have hmono : ∀ y z : ℝ, z ≤ y → Real.rpow ε y ≤ Real.rpow ε z := fun y z hyz =>
   223	      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hpos hε1 hyz
   224	    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
   225	    · exact le_of_eq_of_le hε1'.symm (hmono 1 (1 / 8) (by norm_num))
   226	    · rw [hsqrt]
   227	      exact hmono (1 / 2) (1 / 8) (by norm_num)
   228	    · have hsum : ε + Real.sqrt ε ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt ε := by
   229	        have : ε ≤ Real.sqrt ε := by
   230	          rw [hsqrt]
   231	          exact le_of_eq_of_le hε1'.symm (hmono 1 (1 / 2) (by norm_num))
   232	        linarith
   233	      have hC : 0 ≤ 2 * C₀ := by linarith
   234	      calc Real.rpow (C₀ * (ε + Real.sqrt ε)) (1 / 4 : ℝ)
   235	          ≤ Real.rpow (2 * C₀ * Real.sqrt ε) (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by
   236	            apply Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) _ (by norm_num)
   237	            nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg ε]
   238	        _ = Real.rpow (2 * C₀) (1 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.rpow ε (1 / 8 : ℝ) := by
   239	            change (2 * C₀ * Real.sqrt ε) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) =
   240	              (2 * C₀) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ε ^ (1 / 8 : ℝ)
   241	            rw [Real.mul_rpow hC (Real.sqrt_nonneg ε), Real.sqrt_eq_rpow,
   242	              ← Real.rpow_mul hε]
   243	            norm_num
   244	        _ ≤ 2 * C₀ * Real.rpow ε (1 / 8 : ℝ) := by
   245	            refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (Real.rpow_nonneg hε _)
   246	            calc Real.rpow (2 * C₀) (1 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ Real.rpow (2 * C₀) 1 :=
   247	                  Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by linarith) (by norm_num)
   248	              _ = 2 * C₀ := Real.rpow_one _
   249

     3	/-!
     4	# Self-consistency of the sandwich POVM
     5	
     6	The sandwich POVM `R^{x,z}_{a,b} = M^Z_b M^X_a M^Z_b` of
     7	`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/Sandwich.lean` is approximately self-consistent
     8	between opposite register placements.  The source establishes this by a
     9	Cauchy--Schwarz chain (displays `eq:qld-rw-self-cons-1` to
    10	`eq:qld-rw-self-cons-4`); here an exact identity is used instead.  Writing
    11	`P_1, P_2` for the two placements of an operator `P`,
    12	`W_b = (M^Z_b)_1 (M^Z_b)_2`, and `D^W_c = (M^W_c)_1 - (M^W_c)_2`, the
    13	consistency defect of the two placed sandwiches equals
    14	`(1/2) ∑_b ‖D^Z_b ψ‖^2 + (1/2) ∑_{a,b} ‖D^X_a W_b ψ‖^2`,
    15	by two applications of the identity
    16	`∑_c ⟨w, P_c Q_c w⟩ = ‖w‖^2 - (1/2) ∑_c ‖(P_c - Q_c) w‖^2` for projective
    17	measurements.  The second sum is then bounded by the self-consistency of `M^X`
    18	and the commutators on the two placements, since
    19	`D^X_a W_b = W_b D^X_a + (M^Z_b)_2 K^1_{a,b} - (M^Z_b)_1 K^2_{a,b}`, where
    20	`K^i_{a,b}` is the placed commutator of `M^X_a` and `M^Z_b`.
    21	
    22	## Main results
    23	
    24	* `sandwich_overlap_identity`: the exact expression of the overlap of two
    25	  placed sandwiches.
    26	* `sandwich_defect_pointwise_le`: the pointwise bound on the consistency
    27	  defect of the sandwich for a fixed point pair.
    28	* `ProjectiveSetting.sandwichDefectBound`,
    29	  `ProjectiveSetting.sandwich_offDiagonal_le_sandwichDefectBound`, and
    30	  `ProjectiveSetting.avg_sandwichDefectBound_le`: the bound as a function of
    31	  the point pair, the pointwise estimate, and the average.
    32	
    33	## References
    34	
    35	Paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:743-790`,
    36	blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:851-880`
    37	(`lem:qld-4-10`, first step); the identity route is explained in
    38	`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_linearity-theorem-quotation.tex`.
    39	-/

    51	
    52	/-- The quadratic form of `Wᴴ M W` in `ψ` is the quadratic form of `M` in
    53	`W ψ`. -/
    54	theorem stateQForm_conjTranspose_mul_mul {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    55	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (W M : Op ι) :
    56	    stateQForm ψ (Wᴴ * M * W) = stateQForm (applyOperatorToState W ψ) M := by
    57	  unfold stateQForm
    58	  rw [applyOperatorToState_mul, applyOperatorToState_mul]
    59	  congr 1
    60	  change inner ℂ ψ (Matrix.toEuclideanLin Wᴴ _) =
    61	    inner ℂ (Matrix.toEuclideanLin W ψ) _
    62	  rw [Matrix.toEuclideanLin_conjTranspose_eq_adjoint, LinearMap.adjoint_inner_right]
    63	
    64	/-- The squared norm of `W ψ` is the quadratic form of `Wᴴ W`. -/
    65	theorem norm_applyOperatorToState_sq_eq_stateQForm {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    66	    [DecidableEq ι] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (W : Op ι) :
    67	    ‖applyOperatorToState W ψ‖ ^ 2 = stateQForm ψ (Wᴴ * W) :=
    68	  MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_sq W ψ
    69	
    70	/-- For two projective measurements, the diagonal overlap in a vector `w` is
    71	the squared norm of `w` minus half the summed squared distances.  This is the
    72	identity behind `fact:agreement` for projective families, blueprint
    73	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:260-272`. -/

    97	
    98	section Abstract
    99	
   100	variable {α β ι : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   101	
   102	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary for `lem:qld-4-10`: the product of the two
   103	placed sandwiches is `W_bᴴ (X_1 X_2) W_b` with `W_b = Z_1 Z_2`, whenever the
   104	operators of the two placements commute. -/
   105	theorem sandwich_mul_sandwich_eq (X₁ X₂ : Measurement α ι) (Z₁ Z₂ : Measurement β ι)
   106	    (hXZ : ∀ a b, X₁.effect a * Z₂.effect b = Z₂.effect b * X₁.effect a)
   107	    (hZX : ∀ a b, Z₁.effect b * X₂.effect a = X₂.effect a * Z₁.effect b)
   108	    (hZZ : ∀ b, Z₁.effect b * Z₂.effect b = Z₂.effect b * Z₁.effect b)
   109	    (a : α) (b : β) :
   110	    (Z₁.effect b * X₁.effect a * Z₁.effect b) *
   111	        (Z₂.effect b * X₂.effect a * Z₂.effect b) =
   112	      (Z₁.effect b * Z₂.effect b)ᴴ * (X₁.effect a * X₂.effect a) *
   113	        (Z₁.effect b * Z₂.effect b) := by
   114	  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, measurement_effect_hermitian,
   115	    measurement_effect_hermitian]
   116	  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
   117	  rw [(show Commute (Z₁.effect b) (Z₂.effect b) from hZZ b).left_comm
   118	      (X₂.effect a * Z₂.effect b),
   119	    (show Commute (X₁.effect a) (Z₂.effect b) from hXZ a b).left_comm,
   120	    (show Commute (Z₁.effect b) (Z₂.effect b) from hZZ b).left_comm,
   121	    (show Commute (Z₁.effect b) (X₂.effect a) from hZX a b).left_comm]
   122	
   123	omit [DecidableEq ι] in
   124	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary for `lem:qld-4-10`: the decomposition of
   125	`(X_1 - X_2) Z_1 Z_2` into `Z_1 Z_2 (X_1 - X_2)` and the two commutator
   126	terms. -/
   127	theorem sub_mul_mul_eq_add_commutators (X₁ X₂ Z₁ Z₂ : Op ι)
   128	    (hXZ : X₁ * Z₂ = Z₂ * X₁) (hZX : Z₁ * X₂ = X₂ * Z₁)
   129	    (hZZ : Z₁ * Z₂ = Z₂ * Z₁) :
   130	    (X₁ - X₂) * (Z₁ * Z₂) =
   131	      Z₁ * Z₂ * (X₁ - X₂) + Z₂ * (X₁ * Z₁ - Z₁ * X₁) -
   132	        Z₁ * (X₂ * Z₂ - Z₂ * X₂) := by
   133	  simp only [sub_mul, mul_sub, Matrix.mul_assoc]
   134	  rw [(show Commute Z₂ X₁ from hXZ.symm).left_comm Z₁, ← hZZ,
   135	    (show Commute Z₂ Z₁ from hZZ.symm).left_comm X₁,
   136	    (show Commute Z₁ X₂ from hZX).left_comm Z₂]
   137	  abel
   138	
   139	/-- The overlap of the two placed sandwiches, exactly: with
   140	`W_b = Z_1(b) Z_2(b)`,
   141	`∑_{a,b} ⟨ψ, R_1(a,b) R_2(a,b) ψ⟩ = ‖ψ‖^2 - (1/2) ∑_b ‖(Z_1(b) - Z_2(b)) ψ‖^2
   142	  - (1/2) ∑_{a,b} ‖(X_1(a) - X_2(a)) W_b ψ‖^2`.
   143	This replaces the Cauchy--Schwarz chain of displays
   144	`eq:qld-rw-self-cons-1` to `eq:qld-rw-self-cons-4`, paper
   145	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:743-790`. -/
   146	theorem sandwich_overlap_identity (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι)
   147	    (X₁ X₂ : Measurement α ι) (Z₁ Z₂ : Measurement β ι)
   148	    (hX₁ : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective X₁)
   149	    (hX₂ : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective X₂)
   150	    (hZ₁ : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective Z₁)
   151	    (hZ₂ : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective Z₂)
   152	    (hXZ : ∀ a b, X₁.effect a * Z₂.effect b = Z₂.effect b * X₁.effect a)
   153	    (hZX : ∀ a b, Z₁.effect b * X₂.effect a = X₂.effect a * Z₁.effect b)
   154	    (hZZ : ∀ b, Z₁.effect b * Z₂.effect b = Z₂.effect b * Z₁.effect b) :
   155	    ∑ ab : α × β, stateQForm ψ
   156	        ((Z₁.effect ab.2 * X₁.effect ab.1 * Z₁.effect ab.2) *
   157	          (Z₂.effect ab.2 * X₂.effect ab.1 * Z₂.effect ab.2)) =
   158	      ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 -
   159	        (1 / 2) * ∑ b, ‖applyOperatorToState (Z₁.effect b - Z₂.effect b) ψ‖ ^ 2 -
   160	        (1 / 2) * ∑ ab : α × β, ‖applyOperatorToState (X₁.effect ab.1 - X₂.effect ab.1)
   161	          (applyOperatorToState (Z₁.effect ab.2 * Z₂.effect ab.2) ψ)‖ ^ 2 := by
   162	  have hW : ∀ b, ‖applyOperatorToState (Z₁.effect b * Z₂.effect b) ψ‖ ^ 2 =
   163	      stateQForm ψ (Z₁.effect b * Z₂.effect b) := by
   164	    intro b
   165	    rw [norm_applyOperatorToState_sq_eq_stateQForm, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
   166	      measurement_effect_hermitian, measurement_effect_hermitian]
   167	    congr 1
   168	    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc (Z₁.effect b) (Z₁.effect b),
   169	      (hZ₁ b).isIdempotentElem.eq, hZZ b, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
   170	      (hZ₂ b).isIdempotentElem.eq]
   171	  have hstep : ∀ ab : α × β, stateQForm ψ
   172	      ((Z₁.effect ab.2 * X₁.effect ab.1 * Z₁.effect ab.2) *
   173	        (Z₂.effect ab.2 * X₂.effect ab.1 * Z₂.effect ab.2)) =
   174	      stateQForm (applyOperatorToState (Z₁.effect ab.2 * Z₂.effect ab.2) ψ)
   175	        (X₁.effect ab.1 * X₂.effect ab.1) := by
   176	    intro ab
   177	    rw [sandwich_mul_sandwich_eq X₁ X₂ Z₁ Z₂ hXZ hZX hZZ,
   178	      stateQForm_conjTranspose_mul_mul]
   179	  have hWsum : ∑ b, ‖applyOperatorToState (Z₁.effect b * Z₂.effect b) ψ‖ ^ 2 =
   180	      ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 -
   181	        (1 / 2) * ∑ b, ‖applyOperatorToState (Z₁.effect b - Z₂.effect b) ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   182	    simp_rw [hW]
   183	    exact sum_stateQForm_mul_eq_of_projective Z₁ Z₂ ψ hZ₁ hZ₂
   184	  calc ∑ ab : α × β, stateQForm ψ
   185	        ((Z₁.effect ab.2 * X₁.effect ab.1 * Z₁.effect ab.2) *
   186	          (Z₂.effect ab.2 * X₂.effect ab.1 * Z₂.effect ab.2))
   187	      = ∑ b, ∑ a, stateQForm (applyOperatorToState (Z₁.effect b * Z₂.effect b) ψ)
   188	          (X₁.effect a * X₂.effect a) := by
   189	        simp_rw [hstep]
   190	        exact Fintype.sum_prod_type_right _
   191	    _ = ∑ b, (‖applyOperatorToState (Z₁.effect b * Z₂.effect b) ψ‖ ^ 2 -
   192	          (1 / 2) * ∑ a, ‖applyOperatorToState (X₁.effect a - X₂.effect a)
   193	            (applyOperatorToState (Z₁.effect b * Z₂.effect b) ψ)‖ ^ 2) := by
   194	        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
   195	        exact sum_stateQForm_mul_eq_of_projective X₁ X₂ _ hX₁ hX₂
   196	    _ = _ := by
   197	        rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, hWsum,
   198	          Fintype.sum_prod_type_right]
   199	
   200	/-- The pointwise bound on the consistency defect of the placed sandwiches:
   201	in terms of the distances `D^Z`, `D^X` of the two placements and the placed
   202	commutators `K^1`, `K^2`,
   203	`‖ψ‖^2 - ∑_{a,b} ⟨ψ, R_1 R_2 ψ⟩ ≤ (1/2) D^Z + (3/2) (D^X + K^1 + K^2)`. -/
   204	theorem sandwich_defect_pointwise_le (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι)
   205	    (X₁ X₂ : Measurement α ι) (Z₁ Z₂ : Measurement β ι)
   206	    (hX₁ : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective X₁)
   207	    (hX₂ : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective X₂)
   208	    (hZ₁ : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective Z₁)
   209	    (hZ₂ : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective Z₂)
   210	    (hXZ : ∀ a b, X₁.effect a * Z₂.effect b = Z₂.effect b * X₁.effect a)
   211	    (hZX : ∀ a b, Z₁.effect b * X₂.effect a = X₂.effect a * Z₁.effect b)
   212	    (hZZ : ∀ b, Z₁.effect b * Z₂.effect b = Z₂.effect b * Z₁.effect b) :
   213	    ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 - ∑ ab : α × β, stateQForm ψ
   214	        ((Z₁.effect ab.2 * X₁.effect ab.1 * Z₁.effect ab.2) *
   215	          (Z₂.effect ab.2 * X₂.effect ab.1 * Z₂.effect ab.2)) ≤
   216	      (1 / 2) * ∑ b, ‖applyOperatorToState (Z₁.effect b - Z₂.effect b) ψ‖ ^ 2 +
   217	        (3 / 2) * ((∑ a, ‖applyOperatorToState (X₁.effect a - X₂.effect a) ψ‖ ^ 2) +
   218	          (∑ ab : α × β, ‖applyOperatorToState
   219	            (X₁.effect ab.1 * Z₁.effect ab.2 -
   220	              Z₁.effect ab.2 * X₁.effect ab.1) ψ‖ ^ 2) +
   221	          ∑ ab : α × β, ‖applyOperatorToState
   222	            (X₂.effect ab.1 * Z₂.effect ab.2 -
   223	              Z₂.effect ab.2 * X₂.effect ab.1) ψ‖ ^ 2) := by
   224	  rw [sandwich_overlap_identity ψ X₁ X₂ Z₁ Z₂ hX₁ hX₂ hZ₁ hZ₂ hXZ hZX hZZ]
   225	  -- the pointwise decomposition of `(X_1 - X_2) W_b ψ`
   226	  have hpt : ∀ ab : α × β,
   227	      ‖applyOperatorToState (X₁.effect ab.1 - X₂.effect ab.1)
   228	          (applyOperatorToState (Z₁.effect ab.2 * Z₂.effect ab.2) ψ)‖ ^ 2 ≤
   229	        3 * (‖applyOperatorToState (Z₂.effect ab.2 *
   230	              (X₁.effect ab.1 - X₂.effect ab.1)) ψ‖ ^ 2 +
   231	          ‖applyOperatorToState
   232	            (X₁.effect ab.1 * Z₁.effect ab.2 -
   233	              Z₁.effect ab.2 * X₁.effect ab.1) ψ‖ ^ 2 +
   234	          ‖applyOperatorToState
   235	            (X₂.effect ab.1 * Z₂.effect ab.2 -
   236	              Z₂.effect ab.2 * X₂.effect ab.1) ψ‖ ^ 2) := by
   237	    intro ab
   238	    obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := ab
   239	    rw [← applyOperatorToState_mul, sub_mul_mul_eq_add_commutators _ _ _ _
   240	      (hXZ a b) (hZX a b) (hZZ b)]
   241	    have hlin : applyOperatorToState
   242	        (Z₁.effect b * Z₂.effect b * (X₁.effect a - X₂.effect a) +
   243	          Z₂.effect b * (X₁.effect a * Z₁.effect b - Z₁.effect b * X₁.effect a) -
   244	          Z₁.effect b * (X₂.effect a * Z₂.effect b - Z₂.effect b * X₂.effect a)) ψ =
   245	        applyOperatorToState (Z₁.effect b)
   246	            (applyOperatorToState (Z₂.effect b * (X₁.effect a - X₂.effect a)) ψ) +
   247	          applyOperatorToState (Z₂.effect b) (applyOperatorToState
   248	            (X₁.effect a * Z₁.effect b - Z₁.effect b * X₁.effect a) ψ) -
   249	          applyOperatorToState (Z₁.effect b) (applyOperatorToState
   250	            (X₂.effect a * Z₂.effect b - Z₂.effect b * X₂.effect a) ψ) := by
   251	      rw [← applyOperatorToState_mul, ← applyOperatorToState_mul,
   252	        ← applyOperatorToState_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
   253	      unfold applyOperatorToState
   254	      simp only [map_add, map_sub, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply]
   255	    rw [hlin]
   256	    set u := applyOperatorToState (Z₁.effect b)
   257	      (applyOperatorToState (Z₂.effect b * (X₁.effect a - X₂.effect a)) ψ)
   258	    set v := applyOperatorToState (Z₂.effect b) (applyOperatorToState
   259	      (X₁.effect a * Z₁.effect b - Z₁.effect b * X₁.effect a) ψ)
   260	    set w := applyOperatorToState (Z₁.effect b) (applyOperatorToState
   261	      (X₂.effect a * Z₂.effect b - Z₂.effect b * X₂.effect a) ψ)
   262	    have hu : ‖u‖ ≤ ‖applyOperatorToState
   263	        (Z₂.effect b * (X₁.effect a - X₂.effect a)) ψ‖ :=
   264	      norm_applyOperatorToState_proj_effect_le Z₁ hZ₁ b _
   265	    have hv : ‖v‖ ≤ ‖applyOperatorToState
   266	        (X₁.effect a * Z₁.effect b - Z₁.effect b * X₁.effect a) ψ‖ :=
   267	      norm_applyOperatorToState_proj_effect_le Z₂ hZ₂ b _
   268	    have hw : ‖w‖ ≤ ‖applyOperatorToState
   269	        (X₂.effect a * Z₂.effect b - Z₂.effect b * X₂.effect a) ψ‖ :=
   270	      norm_applyOperatorToState_proj_effect_le Z₁ hZ₁ b _
   271	    have htri : ‖u + v - w‖ ≤ ‖u‖ + ‖v‖ + ‖w‖ :=
   272	      le_trans (norm_sub_le (u + v) w) (add_le_add (norm_add_le u v) (le_refl ‖w‖))
   273	    have hsq : ‖u + v - w‖ ^ 2 ≤ 3 * (‖u‖ ^ 2 + ‖v‖ ^ 2 + ‖w‖ ^ 2) := by
   274	      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖u‖ - ‖v‖), sq_nonneg (‖v‖ - ‖w‖),
   275	        sq_nonneg (‖u‖ - ‖w‖), norm_nonneg (u + v - w), norm_nonneg u,
   276	        norm_nonneg v, norm_nonneg w]
   277	    have hu2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hu 2
   278	    have hv2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hv 2
   279	    have hw2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hw 2
   280	    linarith
   281	  -- the contraction sum over `b`
   282	  have hcontr : ∑ ab : α × β, ‖applyOperatorToState (Z₂.effect ab.2 *
   283	      (X₁.effect ab.1 - X₂.effect ab.1)) ψ‖ ^ 2 ≤
   284	      ∑ a, ‖applyOperatorToState (X₁.effect a - X₂.effect a) ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   285	    simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
   286	    refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ => ?_
   287	    exact sum_norm_mul_apply_le Z₂.effect (X₁.effect a - X₂.effect a) ψ
   288	      (measurement_sum_adjoint_mul_le_one Z₂)
   289	  have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum fun ab (_ : ab ∈ Finset.univ) => hpt ab
   290	  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib] at hsum
   291	  linarith
   292	
   293	end Abstract

   295	/-! ## The bound for the placed sandwiches -/
   296	
   297	namespace ProjectiveSetting
   298	
   299	variable {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
   300	
   301	/-- The pointwise bound on the consistency defect of the sandwich POVM between
   302	two placements, as a function of the point pair: one half of the
   303	`Z`-distance plus three halves of the `X`-distance and of the two placed
   304	commutator sums. -/
   305	def sandwichDefectBound (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p₁ p₂ : Placement)
   306	    (xz : PointPair P) : ℝ :=
   307	  (1 / 2) * ∑ b : PauliScalar P, ‖applyOperatorToState
   308	      (S.place p₁ ((S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .Z xz.2).effect b) -
   309	        S.place p₂ ((S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .Z xz.2).effect b)) S.psiHat‖ ^ 2 +
   310	    (3 / 2) * ((∑ a : PauliScalar P, ‖applyOperatorToState
   311	        (S.place p₁ ((S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .X xz.1).effect a) -
   312	          S.place p₂ ((S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .X xz.1).effect a)) S.psiHat‖ ^ 2) +
   313	      (∑ ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P, ‖applyOperatorToState
   314	        (S.place p₁ ((S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1 *
   315	            (S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2) -
   316	          S.place p₁ ((S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2 *
   317	            (S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1)) S.psiHat‖ ^ 2) +
   318	      ∑ ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P, ‖applyOperatorToState
   319	        (S.place p₂ ((S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1 *
   320	            (S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2) -
   321	          S.place p₂ ((S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2 *
   322	            (S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1)) S.psiHat‖ ^ 2)
   323	
   324	/-- The pointwise bound is nonnegative. -/
   325	theorem sandwichDefectBound_nonneg (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p₁ p₂ : Placement)
   326	    (xz : PointPair P) : 0 ≤ S.sandwichDefectBound p₁ p₂ xz := by
   327	  unfold sandwichDefectBound
   328	  positivity
   329	
   330	/-- For a fixed point pair, the off-diagonal mass of the two placed sandwiches
   331	is at most the pointwise bound.  This is the consistency of the sandwich POVM
   332	between opposite placements, display `eq:rw-sc` of the proof of
   333	`lem:qld-4-10`, paper
   334	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:743-790`, in
   335	exact form. -/
   336	theorem sandwich_offDiagonal_le_sandwichDefectBound (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
   337	    (p₁ p₂ : Placement) (hopp : p₁.IsOpposite p₂) (xz : PointPair P) :
   338	    (∑ ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P, ∑ ab' : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P,
   339	      if ab = ab' then 0 else stateQForm S.psiHat
   340	        (S.place p₁ ((S.sandwichPoint p₁.side xz.1 xz.2).effect ab) *
   341	          S.place p₂ ((S.sandwichPoint p₂.side xz.1 xz.2).effect ab'))) ≤
   342	      S.sandwichDefectBound p₁ p₂ xz := by
   343	  have hdefect := point_defect_eq
   344	    (S.placedMeasurement p₁ (S.sandwichPoint p₁.side xz.1 xz.2))
   345	    (S.placedMeasurement p₂ (S.sandwichPoint p₂.side xz.1 xz.2)) S.psiHat
   346	  simp only [placedMeasurement_effect] at hdefect
   347	  rw [hdefect, psiHat_norm]
   348	  have hkey := sandwich_defect_pointwise_le S.psiHat
   349	    (S.placedMeasurement p₁ (S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .X xz.1))
   350	    (S.placedMeasurement p₂ (S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .X xz.1))
   351	    (S.placedMeasurement p₁ (S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .Z xz.2))
   352	    (S.placedMeasurement p₂ (S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .Z xz.2))
   353	    (S.placedMeasurement_isProjective p₁ _ (S.pointMeasExp_isProjective _ _ _))
   354	    (S.placedMeasurement_isProjective p₂ _ (S.pointMeasExp_isProjective _ _ _))
   355	    (S.placedMeasurement_isProjective p₁ _ (S.pointMeasExp_isProjective _ _ _))
   356	    (S.placedMeasurement_isProjective p₂ _ (S.pointMeasExp_isProjective _ _ _))
   357	    (fun a b => S.place_comm p₁ p₂ hopp _ _)
   358	    (fun a b => S.place_comm p₁ p₂ hopp _ _)
   359	    (fun b => S.place_comm p₁ p₂ hopp _ _)
   360	  simp only [placedMeasurement_effect, psiHat_norm] at hkey
   361	  unfold sandwichDefectBound
   362	  simp only [sandwichPoint_effect, place_mul]
   363	  simpa only [place_mul] using hkey
   364	
   365	/-- The average over the point pair of the pointwise bound is polynomially
   366	small: at most a universal constant times `ε + √ε`.  The `X`- and
   367	`Z`-distances are the self-consistency of item 1 of `lem:qld-comm-cons`, and
   368	the two commutator sums are the field-valued commutation estimate. -/
   369	theorem avg_sandwichDefectBound_le :

   779			lem:fourier-square-measurement, lem:naimark-rounding}
   780		Let $\hilb'$ have orthonormal basis indexed by $\F_2^t$ together with one
   781		extra element $\bot$, and take $\ket{\mathrm{anc}} = \ket{\bot}$, the
   782		initial state of the auxiliary register in the one-measurement Naimark
   783		construction of Lemma~\ref{lem:naimark-helper}. Apply that construction to
   784		the Fourier-square POVM $\{B^u\}$ of
   785		Lemma~\ref{lem:fourier-square-measurement}. It returns
   786		projectors indexed by $\F_2^t \cup \{\bot\}$; the residual projector at
   787		$\bot$ is folded into the outcome $u = 0$, so that the resulting family
   788		$\{C^u\}_{u \in \F_2^t}$ is still a family of orthogonal projectors summing
   789		to $\Id_{\hilb \ot \hilb'}$ and still compresses to $B^u$ along
   790		$\ket{\mathrm{anc}}$, the latter because $\sum_u B^u = \Id_{\hilb}$. Set
   791		$\mathcal{L}^a = \sum_u \chi_u(a) \, C^u$; orthogonality of the $C^u$ and
   792		multiplicativity of the characters give
   793		$\mathcal{L}^a \mathcal{L}^b = \mathcal{L}^{a+b}$ and
   794		$(\mathcal{L}^a)^2 = \Id$, and each $\mathcal{L}^a$ is Hermitian because
   795		the characters are real. Since $\rho'$ is a density operator and both
   796		$\mathcal{L}^a$ and $\mathcal{O}^a \ot \Id_{\hilb'}$ are binary
   797		observables, Lemma~\ref{lem:binary-measurement-distance} gives
   798		\[
   799			d_{\rho'}\big(\mathcal{L}^a, \mathcal{O}^a \ot \Id_{\hilb'}\big)^2
   800			= 2 - 2 \, \Re \Tr\big(\mathcal{L}^a \,
   801			(\mathcal{O}^a \ot \Id_{\hilb'}) \, \rho'\big) ,
   802		\]

   804		$\mathcal{O}^a \ot \Id_{\hilb'}$ into the weight and compressing
   805		$\mathcal{L}^a$ along $\ket{\mathrm{anc}}$ rewrites the trace as
   806		$\Re \Tr\big(\mathcal{O}^a \, (\sum_u \chi_u(a) B^u) \, \rho\big)$.

   808		Lemma~\ref{lem:fourier-square-measurement} turns the average into
   809		$2 - 2 \, C_\rho(\mathcal{O})$, which is the mean multiplicative defect by
   810		Lemma~\ref{lem:blr-defect-identity}. No commutation among the
   811		$\mathcal{O}^u$ is used. The hypothesis then bounds the average by $\eta$.
   812	\end{proof}

 /-- The state-dependent distance of two square-summable families is at most
 `4` on a unit vector, under a uniform distribution. -/
 theorem opFamilyDistSq_uniform_le_four {X α ι : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
     [Nonempty X] [Fintype α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
     (A B : X → α → Op ι) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1)
     (hA : ∀ x, ∑ a, (A x a)ᴴ * A x a ≤ 1) (hB : ∀ x, ∑ a, (B x a)ᴴ * B x a ≤ 1) :
     opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution X) A B ψ ≤ 4 := by
   unfold opFamilyDistSq
   calc avgOver (uniformDistribution X) (fun x =>
         ∑ a, ‖applyOperatorToState (A x a - B x a) ψ‖ ^ 2)
       ≤ avgOver (uniformDistribution X) (fun _ => (4 : ℝ)) := by
         exact avgOver_mono _ _ _ fun x =>
           sum_norm_sub_apply_sq_le_four (A x) (B x) ψ hψ (hA x) (hB x)
     _ = 4 := avgOver_uniform_const _

     [Fintype β] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

   have hpt : ∀ (a : α) (b : β),

         B.effect b * A.effect a * B.effect b := by
     intro a b
     rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, (hA a).isSelfAdjoint.isHermitian.eq,
       (hB b).isSelfAdjoint.isHermitian.eq, Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ (A.effect a * B.effect b),

   rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type_right]

 \section{Combined point measurements}
 
 The measurements $\hat{M}^{(\mathrm{Point},X),x}$ and
 $\hat{M}^{(\mathrm{Point},Z),z}$ commute only approximately. The first goal of
 this chapter is to construct a single projective measurement that
 simultaneously measures both, first at points and then along lines. The
 source construction of the combined point measurement proceeds in three steps: the
 binary refinements $\hat{M}^{(\mathrm{Point},X),x,r}$ and
 $\hat{M}^{(\mathrm{Point},Z),z,s}$ are combined into a sandwich POVM, the
 resulting family is shown to satisfy an approximate linearity in the index

 Vidick~\cite{Natarajan2017Linearity} converts approximate linearity into exact
 linearity, from which a projective measurement with outcomes in $\F_q^2$ is
 obtained by Fourier averaging. The proof of Lemma~\ref{lem:qld-4-10} below

 transfers the commutation estimate without a field-size loss, so this argument
 does not use quantum linearity or further zero-state padding; the replacement
 is explained in \cite{gap:qpbt_linearity-theorem-quotation}. We retain the
 linearity theorem and its source application separately.

   213	            (S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1) -
   214	          S.place p₁ ((S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2) *
   215	            S.place p₂ ((S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1) =
   216	          S.place p₁ ((S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2) *
   217	            (S.place p₁ ((S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1) -
   218	              S.place p₂ ((S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1)) := by
   219	      intro ab
   220	      rw [S.place_mul p₁ ((S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2)
   221	        ((S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1), mul_sub]
   222	    simp only [hpt, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
   223	    refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ => ?_
   224	    exact DistanceCalculus.sum_norm_mul_apply_le
   225	      (fun b => S.place p₁ ((S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .Z xz.2).effect b))
   226	      (S.place p₁ ((S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .X xz.1).effect a) -
   227	        S.place p₂ ((S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .X xz.1).effect a)) S.psiHat
   228	      (measurement_sum_adjoint_mul_le_one
   229	        (S.placedMeasurement p₁ (S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .Z xz.2)))
   230	  have h₂ : opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution (PointPair P))
   231	      (fun xz (ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P) =>
   232	        S.place p₁ ((S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2) *
   233	          S.place p₂ ((S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1))
   234	      (fun xz ab => S.place p₂
   235	        ((S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1 *
   236	          (S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2))
   237	      S.psiHat ≤ C * ε := by
   238	    refine le_trans ?_ (le_of_eq_of_le (avgOver_uniform_snd
   239	      (α := Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
   240	      (fun z => ∑ b : PauliScalar P, ‖applyOperatorToState

   242	          S.place p₂ ((S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .Z z).effect b)) S.psiHat‖ ^ 2)) hZ)
   243	    unfold opFamilyDistSq
   244	    refine avgOver_mono _ _ _ fun xz => ?_
   245	    have hpt : ∀ ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P,
   246	        S.place p₁ ((S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2) *
   247	            S.place p₂ ((S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1) -
   248	          S.place p₂ ((S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1 *
   249	            (S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2) =

   251	            (S.place p₁ ((S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2) -
   252	              S.place p₂ ((S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2)) := by
   253	      intro ab
   254	      rw [S.place_mul p₂ ((S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1)
   255	        ((S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2),
   256	        S.place_comm p₁ p₂ hopp ((S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2)
   257	          ((S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1), ← mul_sub]
   258	    simp only [hpt, Fintype.sum_prod_type_right]
   259	    refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun b _ => ?_
   260	    exact DistanceCalculus.sum_norm_mul_apply_le
   261	      (fun a => S.place p₂ ((S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .X xz.1).effect a))

   263	        S.place p₂ ((S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .Z xz.2).effect b)) S.psiHat
   264	      (measurement_sum_adjoint_mul_le_one
   265	        (S.placedMeasurement p₂ (S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .X xz.1)))
   266	  have htri := opFamilyDistSq_le_of_le_of_le (uniformDistribution (PointPair P))
   267	    _ _ _ S.psiHat (C * ε) (C * ε) h₁ h₂

     3	/-!
     4	# Placement calculus on the expanded state
     5	
     6	This module records the algebra of the four register placements used by the
     7	combining argument: a placement is a unital `*`-homomorphism, placements on
     8	opposite register pairs commute, and the crosswise exchange of the two EPR
     9	pairs of the expanded state carries the placement `AA'` to `AB''` and `BA''`
    10	to `BB'` while fixing the expanded state.  The last fact transfers every
    11	state-dependent distance between the two bipartition schemes of
    12	`def:symmetric-equivalents` without assuming a symmetric strategy.
    13	
    14	## References
    15	
    16	The placements are those of `def:symmetric-equivalents`, blueprint
    17	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:1003-1030`, paper
    18	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:420-450`.  The
    19	EPR-exchange invariance is the element `U_σ U_θ` of
    20	`lem:symmetric-equivalents-transfer`, blueprint
    21	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:1032-1130`, which needs no
    22	symmetry of the strategy; its use for `lem:qld-4-10` is analyzed in
    23	`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_linearity-theorem-quotation.tex`.
    24	-/

    41	/-- The `AA'` placement is the reindexed left factor of the
    42	`AA' | BA''(B'B'')` bipartition. -/
    43	theorem place_AA'_eq (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    44	    (O : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace Placement.AA'.side)) :
    45	    S.place .AA' O =
    46	      reindexOp (aaBaBipartition P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
    47	        (heteroKron O
    48	          (1 : Op ((S.toStrategy.ιB × PauliRegister P) ×
    49	            (PauliRegister P × PauliRegister P)))) :=
    50	  (reindexOp_aaBaBipartition_left S O).symm
    51	
    52	/-- The `BA''` placement is the reindexed right factor of the
    53	`AA' | BA''(B'B'')` bipartition. -/
    54	theorem place_BA''_eq (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    55	    (O : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace Placement.BA''.side)) :
    56	    S.place .BA'' O =
    57	      reindexOp (aaBaBipartition P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
    58	        (heteroKron (1 : Op (S.toStrategy.ιA × PauliRegister P))
    59	          (heteroKron O (1 : Op (PauliRegister P × PauliRegister P)))) :=
    60	  (reindexOp_aaBaBipartition_right S O).symm
    61	
    62	/-- The `AB''` placement is the reindexed left factor of the
    63	`AB'' | BB'(A'A'')` bipartition. -/
    64	theorem place_AB''_eq (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    65	    (O : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace Placement.AB''.side)) :
    66	    S.place .AB'' O =
    67	      reindexOp (abBbBipartition P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
    68	        (heteroKron O
    69	          (1 : Op ((S.toStrategy.ιB × PauliRegister P) ×
    70	            (PauliRegister P × PauliRegister P)))) :=
    71	  (reindexOp_abBbBipartition_left S O).symm
    72	
    73	/-- The `BB'` placement is the reindexed right factor of the
    74	`AB'' | BB'(A'A'')` bipartition. -/
    75	theorem place_BB'_eq (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    76	    (O : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace Placement.BB'.side)) :
    77	    S.place .BB' O =
    78	      reindexOp (abBbBipartition P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
    79	        (heteroKron (1 : Op (S.toStrategy.ιA × PauliRegister P))
    80	          (heteroKron O (1 : Op (PauliRegister P × PauliRegister P)))) :=
    81	  (reindexOp_abBbBipartition_right S O).symm

    83	/-- Reindexing an operator commutes with the conjugate transpose. -/
    84	theorem reindexOp_conjTranspose {ι κ : Type*} (e : ι ≃ κ) (M : Op κ) :
    85	    reindexOp e Mᴴ = (reindexOp e M)ᴴ := by
    86	  ext i j
    87	  rfl
    88	
    89	/-- Reindexing an operator along an equivalence preserves positivity. -/
    90	theorem reindexOp_nonneg {ι κ : Type*} [Finite ι] [Finite κ]
    91	    (e : ι ≃ κ) {M : Op κ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) :
    92	    0 ≤ reindexOp e M := by
    93	  letI := Fintype.ofFinite ι
    94	  letI := Fintype.ofFinite κ
    95	  rw [Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef] at hM ⊢
    96	  exact hM.submatrix e.symm.symm

   100	set_option synthInstance.maxSize 400 in
   101	/-- A placement is multiplicative. -/
   102	theorem place_mul (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) :
   103	    ∀ (p : Placement) (A B : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)),
   104	      S.place p (A * B) = S.place p A * S.place p B
   105	  | .AA', A, B => by
   106	      classical
   107	      rw [place_AA'_eq, place_AA'_eq, place_AA'_eq,
   108	        ← WinImplications.reindexOp_mul, heteroKron_mul, mul_one]
   109	      all_goals rfl
   110	  | .BA'', A, B => by
   111	      classical
   112	      rw [place_BA''_eq, place_BA''_eq, place_BA''_eq,
   113	        ← WinImplications.reindexOp_mul, heteroKron_mul, heteroKron_mul,
   114	        mul_one, mul_one]
   115	      all_goals rfl
   116	  | .BB', A, B => by
   117	      classical
   118	      rw [place_BB'_eq, place_BB'_eq, place_BB'_eq,
   119	        ← WinImplications.reindexOp_mul, heteroKron_mul, heteroKron_mul,
   120	        mul_one, mul_one]
   121	      all_goals rfl
   122	  | .AB'', A, B => by
   123	      classical
   124	      rw [place_AB''_eq, place_AB''_eq, place_AB''_eq,
   125	        ← WinImplications.reindexOp_mul, heteroKron_mul, mul_one]
   126	      all_goals rfl
   127	
   128	/-- A placement sends the local identity to the identity of the six-register
   129	space. -/
   130	theorem place_one (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p : Placement) :
   131	    S.place p (1 : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)) = 1 := by
   132	  ext i j
   133	  cases p <;>
   134	    · simp only [ProjectiveSetting.place, Matrix.one_apply, Prod.ext_iff]
   135	      split_ifs <;> simp_all
   136	
   137	/-- A placement is additive over finite sums of local operators. -/
   138	theorem place_finsetSum (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p : Placement) {γ : Type*}
   139	    (s : Finset γ) (O : γ → Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)) :
   140	    S.place p (∑ x ∈ s, O x) = ∑ x ∈ s, S.place p (O x) := by
   141	  ext i j
   142	  cases p <;>
   143	    simp only [ProjectiveSetting.place, Matrix.sum_apply, Finset.sum_mul,
   144	      Finset.mul_sum]
   145	
   146	/-- A placement commutes with the conjugate transpose. -/
   147	theorem place_conjTranspose (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) :
   148	    ∀ (p : Placement) (A : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)),
   149	      S.place p Aᴴ = (S.place p A)ᴴ
   150	  | .AA', A => by
   151	      rw [place_AA'_eq, place_AA'_eq, ← reindexOp_conjTranspose,
   152	        WinImplications.heteroKron_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_one]
   153	      all_goals rfl
   154	  | .BA'', A => by
   155	      rw [place_BA''_eq, place_BA''_eq, ← reindexOp_conjTranspose,
   156	        WinImplications.heteroKron_conjTranspose,
   157	        WinImplications.heteroKron_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_one,
   158	        Matrix.conjTranspose_one]
   159	      all_goals rfl
   160	  | .BB', A => by
   161	      rw [place_BB'_eq, place_BB'_eq, ← reindexOp_conjTranspose,
   162	        WinImplications.heteroKron_conjTranspose,
   163	        WinImplications.heteroKron_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_one,
   164	        Matrix.conjTranspose_one]
   165	      all_goals rfl
   166	  | .AB'', A => by
   167	      rw [place_AB''_eq, place_AB''_eq, ← reindexOp_conjTranspose,
   168	        WinImplications.heteroKron_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_one]
   169	      all_goals rfl

   171	set_option synthInstance.maxSize 400 in
   172	/-- A placement preserves positivity. -/
   173	theorem place_nonneg (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) :
   174	    ∀ (p : Placement) {A : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)}, 0 ≤ A →
   175	      0 ≤ S.place p A
   176	  | .AA', A, hA => by
   177	      classical
   178	      rw [place_AA'_eq]
   179	      exact reindexOp_nonneg _ (MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg hA
   180	        (Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg))
   181	  | .BA'', A, hA => by
   182	      classical
   183	      rw [place_BA''_eq]
   184	      exact reindexOp_nonneg _ (MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg
   185	        (Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg)
   186	        (MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg hA (Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg)))
   187	  | .BB', A, hA => by
   188	      classical
   189	      rw [place_BB'_eq]
   190	      exact reindexOp_nonneg _ (MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg
   191	        (Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg)
   192	        (MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg hA (Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg)))
   193	  | .AB'', A, hA => by
   194	      classical
   195	      rw [place_AB''_eq]
   196	      exact reindexOp_nonneg _ (MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg hA
   197	        (Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg))
   198	
   199	/-- The placement of a local operator bounded by the identity is bounded by
   200	the identity. -/
   201	theorem place_le_one (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p : Placement)
   202	    {A : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)} (hA : A ≤ 1) :
   203	    S.place p A ≤ 1 := by
   204	  have h : 0 ≤ S.place p (1 - A) := S.place_nonneg p (sub_nonneg.mpr hA)
   205	  rw [place_sub, place_one] at h
   206	  exact sub_nonneg.mp h
   207	
   208	/-- The placement of a projector is a contraction. -/
   209	theorem place_conjTranspose_mul_self_le_one (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
   210	    (p : Placement) {E : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)} (hE : IsProj E) :
   211	    (S.place p E)ᴴ * S.place p E ≤ 1 := by
   212	  rw [← place_conjTranspose, ← place_mul, hE.isSelfAdjoint.isHermitian.eq,
   213	    hE.isIdempotentElem.eq]
   214	  exact S.place_le_one p (sub_nonneg.mp hE.one_sub.nonneg)

   217	/-- Operators placed on opposite register pairs commute. -/
   218	theorem place_comm (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) :
   219	    ∀ (p₁ p₂ : Placement), p₁.IsOpposite p₂ →
   220	      ∀ (A : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₁.side))
   221	        (B : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₂.side)),
   222	        S.place p₁ A * S.place p₂ B = S.place p₂ B * S.place p₁ A
   223	  | .AA', .BA'', _, A, B => by
   224	      classical
   225	      rw [place_AA'_eq, place_BA''_eq, ← WinImplications.reindexOp_mul,
   226	        ← WinImplications.reindexOp_mul]
   227	      simp only [heteroKron_mul, one_mul, mul_one]
   228	  | .BA'', .AA', _, A, B => by
   229	      classical
   230	      rw [place_AA'_eq, place_BA''_eq, ← WinImplications.reindexOp_mul,
   231	        ← WinImplications.reindexOp_mul]
   232	      simp only [heteroKron_mul, one_mul, mul_one]
   233	  | .BB', .AB'', _, A, B => by
   234	      classical
   235	      rw [place_AB''_eq, place_BB'_eq, ← WinImplications.reindexOp_mul,
   236	        ← WinImplications.reindexOp_mul]
   237	      simp only [heteroKron_mul, one_mul, mul_one]
   238	  | .AB'', .BB', _, A, B => by
   239	      classical
   240	      rw [place_AB''_eq, place_BB'_eq, ← WinImplications.reindexOp_mul,
   241	        ← WinImplications.reindexOp_mul]
   242	      simp only [heteroKron_mul, one_mul, mul_one]
   243	  | .AA', .AA', h, _, _ => by simp [Placement.IsOpposite] at h
   244	  | .AA', .BB', h, _, _ => by simp [Placement.IsOpposite] at h
   245	  | .AA', .AB'', h, _, _ => by simp [Placement.IsOpposite] at h
   246	  | .BA'', .BA'', h, _, _ => by simp [Placement.IsOpposite] at h
   247	  | .BA'', .BB', h, _, _ => by simp [Placement.IsOpposite] at h
   248	  | .BA'', .AB'', h, _, _ => by simp [Placement.IsOpposite] at h
   249	  | .BB', .AA', h, _, _ => by simp [Placement.IsOpposite] at h
   250	  | .BB', .BA'', h, _, _ => by simp [Placement.IsOpposite] at h
   251	  | .BB', .BB', h, _, _ => by simp [Placement.IsOpposite] at h
   252	  | .AB'', .AA', h, _, _ => by simp [Placement.IsOpposite] at h
   253	  | .AB'', .BA'', h, _, _ => by simp [Placement.IsOpposite] at h
   254	  | .AB'', .AB'', h, _, _ => by simp [Placement.IsOpposite] at h

   256	/-- A complete measurement on a local expanded space, placed on one of the
   257	four register pairs, is a complete measurement on the six-register space. -/
   258	def placedMeasurement (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p : Placement) {α : Type*}
   259	    [Fintype α] (M : Measurement α (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)) :
   260	    Measurement α (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) :=
   261	  Measurement.ofSumEqOne (fun a => S.place p (M.effect a))
   262	    (fun a => S.place_nonneg p (M.pos a))
   263	    (by rw [← place_finsetSum, M.sum_eq_one, place_one])
   264	
   265	/-- The effects of a placed measurement are the placed effects. -/
   266	@[simp] theorem placedMeasurement_effect (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
   267	    (p : Placement) {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
   268	    (M : Measurement α (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)) (a : α) :
   269	    (S.placedMeasurement p M).effect a = S.place p (M.effect a) := rfl
   270	
   271	/-- A placed projective measurement is projective. -/
   272	theorem placedMeasurement_isProjective (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
   273	    (p : Placement) {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
   274	    (M : Measurement α (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side))
   275	    (hM : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective M) :
   276	    MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (S.placedMeasurement p M) := by
   277	  intro a
   278	  refine isStarProjection_iff'.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩
   279	  · change S.place p (M.effect a) * S.place p (M.effect a) =
   280	      S.place p (M.effect a)
   281	    rw [← place_mul, (hM a).isIdempotentElem.eq]
   282	  · change star (S.place p (M.effect a)) = S.place p (M.effect a)
   283	    rw [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, ← place_conjTranspose,
   284	      (hM a).isSelfAdjoint.isHermitian.eq]

   286	/-! ## The crosswise exchange of the two EPR pairs -/
   287	
   288	/-- The permutation of the six registers exchanging `A'` with `B''` and `A''`
   289	with `B'`.  It is the element `U_σ U_θ` of
   290	`lem:symmetric-equivalents-transfer`, blueprint
   291	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:1032-1130`; unlike the
   292	generators there it does not touch the strategy registers. -/
   293	def eprCrossSwap (P : AdmissibleParams) (ιA ιB : Type*) :
   294	    SixReg P ιA ιB ≃ SixReg P ιA ιB where
   295	  toFun := fun ⟨⟨a, a', a''⟩, b, b', b''⟩ => ((a, (b'', b')), (b, (a'', a')))
   296	  invFun := fun ⟨⟨a, a', a''⟩, b, b', b''⟩ => ((a, (b'', b')), (b, (a'', a')))
   297	  left_inv := by rintro ⟨⟨a, a', a''⟩, b, b', b''⟩; rfl
   298	  right_inv := by rintro ⟨⟨a, a', a''⟩, b, b', b''⟩; rfl
   299	
   300	/-- The EPR vector is symmetric in its two registers. -/
   301	theorem eprState_ofLp_swap {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
   302	    [Nonempty V] (x y : V) :
   303	    (eprState V).ofLp (x, y) = (eprState V).ofLp (y, x) := by
   304	  change (if x = y then (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card V : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ else 0) =
   305	    (if y = x then (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card V : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ else 0)
   306	  by_cases h : x = y
   307	  · simp [h]
   308	  · simp [h, Ne.symm h]
   309	
   310	/-- The crosswise EPR exchange fixes the expanded state.  This is item 1 of
   311	`lem:symmetric-equivalents-transfer` for the element `U_σ U_θ`, blueprint
   312	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:1032-1130`; only the symmetry
   313	of the EPR vector is used. -/

     4	/-!
     5	# Orthonormalization of the sandwich POVM
     6	
     7	For each fixed point pair `(x, z)`, the sandwich POVM `R^{x,z}` on one
     8	register placement is consistent with the sandwich POVM on the opposite
     9	placement, with the consistency defect bounded by
    10	`ProjectiveSetting.sandwichDefectBound`.  The orthonormalization lemma
    11	`lem:ortho`, in its explicit-constant form
    12	`projective_rounding_with_explicit_constant`, therefore produces a projective
    13	measurement `Q^{x,z}` on the original local space, within `220 · c^{1/4}` of
    14	`R^{x,z}` on the expanded state, where `c` is that bound.  Choosing such a
    15	measurement for every pair and averaging, the concavity of `t ↦ t^{1/4}`
    16	turns the average of the fiberwise errors into the same function of the
    17	average defect.
    18	
    19	The orthonormalization lemma is stated for a bipartite state whose first
    20	tensor factor carries the POVM to be rounded.  The two bipartitions used are
    21	`AA' | BA''(B'B'')`, for Alice's measurements, and `BA'' | AA'(B'B'')`, for
    22	Bob's; the second is introduced here.
    23	
    24	## Main results
    25	
    26	* `baAaBipartition` with its two placement lemmas.
    27	* `avgOver_rpow_quarter_le`: Jensen's inequality for the fourth root.
    28	* `ProjectiveSetting.exists_projective_close_sandwich`: the fiberwise
    29	  orthonormalization, for any bipartition exhibiting the two placements as
    30	  the two tensor factors.
    31	
    32	## References
    33	
    34	Paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:786-790`
    35	(the application of the orthonormalization lemma), blueprint
    36	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:870-878` (`lem:qld-4-10`), and
    37	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:395-464` (`lem:ortho`); the
    38	route is explained in `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_linearity-theorem-quotation.tex`.
    39	-/

    50	/-! ## Jensen's inequality for the fourth root -/
    51	
    52	/-- The fourth root of a nonnegative real is the iterated square root. -/
    53	theorem rpow_quarter_eq_sqrt_sqrt {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    54	    Real.rpow t (1 / 4 : ℝ) = Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt t) := by
    55	  rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_mul ht]
    56	  norm_num
    57	
    58	/-- Jensen's inequality for the concave function `t ↦ t^{1/4}` on a
    59	sub-probability average, obtained by applying the square-root inequality
    60	twice. -/
    61	theorem avgOver_rpow_quarter_le {X : Type*} (𝒟 : Distribution X)
    62	    (h𝒟 : ∑ x ∈ 𝒟.support, 𝒟.weight x ≤ 1) (b : X → ℝ) (hb : ∀ x, 0 ≤ b x) :
    63	    avgOver 𝒟 (fun x => Real.rpow (b x) (1 / 4 : ℝ)) ≤
    64	      Real.rpow (avgOver 𝒟 b) (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by
    65	  have h1 : |avgOver 𝒟 (fun x => Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (b x)))| ≤
    66	      Real.sqrt (avgOver 𝒟 (fun x => Real.sqrt (b x))) :=
    67	    MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.avgOver_abs_le_sqrt_of_pointwise 𝒟 _ _
    68	      (fun x => by rw [abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)])
    69	      (fun x => Real.sqrt_nonneg _) h𝒟
    70	  have h2 : |avgOver 𝒟 (fun x => Real.sqrt (b x))| ≤ Real.sqrt (avgOver 𝒟 b) :=
    71	    MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.avgOver_abs_le_sqrt_of_pointwise 𝒟 _ _
    72	      (fun x => by rw [abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]) hb h𝒟
    73	  have havg : 0 ≤ avgOver 𝒟 b := avgOver_nonneg 𝒟 b hb
    74	  rw [rpow_quarter_eq_sqrt_sqrt havg]
    75	  calc avgOver 𝒟 (fun x => Real.rpow (b x) (1 / 4 : ℝ))
    76	      = avgOver 𝒟 (fun x => Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (b x))) :=
    77	        avgOver_congr _ _ _ fun x => rpow_quarter_eq_sqrt_sqrt (hb x)
    78	    _ ≤ |avgOver 𝒟 (fun x => Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (b x)))| := le_abs_self _
    79	    _ ≤ Real.sqrt (avgOver 𝒟 (fun x => Real.sqrt (b x))) := h1
    80	    _ ≤ Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (avgOver 𝒟 b)) :=
    81	        Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (le_trans (le_abs_self _) h2)

   145	/-- The consistency defect of two placed POVMs, read in the bipartite picture
   146	of the reindexed expanded state, is their off-diagonal mass in the expanded
   147	state. -/
   148	theorem consistencyDefect_reindex_eq {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   149	    (e : SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB ≃
   150	      S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₁.side ×
   151	        (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₂.side × (PauliRegister P × PauliRegister P)))
   152	    (he₁ : ∀ O : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₁.side),
   153	      reindexOp e (heteroKron O
   154	        (1 : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₂.side ×
   155	          (PauliRegister P × PauliRegister P)))) = S.place p₁ O)
   156	    (he₂ : ∀ O : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₂.side),
   157	      reindexOp e (heteroKron (1 : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₁.side))
   158	        (heteroKron O (1 : Op (PauliRegister P × PauliRegister P)))) =
   159	          S.place p₂ O)
   160	    (Q : Measurement α (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₁.side))
   161	    (R : Measurement α (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₂.side)) :
   162	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution Unit)
   163	        (fun _ a => heteroKron (Q.effect a) 1)
   164	        (fun _ a => heteroKron 1
   165	          ((leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := PauliRegister P × PauliRegister P) R).effect a))
   166	        (reindexState e S.psiHat) =
   167	      ∑ a : α, ∑ b : α, if a = b then 0 else
   168	        stateQForm S.psiHat (S.place p₁ (Q.effect a) * S.place p₂ (R.effect b)) := by
   169	  classical
   170	  unfold consistencyDefect
   171	  rw [avgOver_uniform_const]
   172	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
   173	  by_cases hab : a = b
   174	  · simp [hab]
   175	  · rw [if_neg hab, if_neg hab, consistency_term_eq_stateQForm,
   176	      WinImplications.stateQForm_reindexState, WinImplications.reindexOp_mul, he₁]
   177	    change stateQForm S.psiHat (S.place p₁ (Q.effect a) *
   178	      reindexOp e (heteroKron 1 (heteroKron (R.effect b) 1))) = _
   179	    rw [he₂]

   182	/-- The state-dependent distance of two families placed on the first factor,
   183	read in the bipartite picture, is their placed distance in the expanded
   184	state. -/
   185	theorem opFamilyDistSq_reindex_left_eq {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
   186	    (e : SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB ≃
   187	      S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₁.side ×
   188	        (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₂.side × (PauliRegister P × PauliRegister P)))
   189	    (he₁ : ∀ O : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₁.side),
   190	      reindexOp e (heteroKron O
   191	        (1 : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₂.side ×
   192	          (PauliRegister P × PauliRegister P)))) = S.place p₁ O)
   193	    (A B : α → Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₁.side)) :
   194	    opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
   195	        (fun _ a => heteroKron (A a) 1) (fun _ a => heteroKron (B a) 1)
   196	        (reindexState e S.psiHat) =
   197	      ∑ a : α, ‖applyOperatorToState (S.place p₁ (A a) - S.place p₁ (B a))
   198	        S.psiHat‖ ^ 2 := by
   199	  classical
   200	  unfold opFamilyDistSq
   201	  rw [avgOver_uniform_const]
   202	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
   203	  rw [WinImplications.norm_applyOperatorToState_reindexState,
   204	    WinImplications.reindexOp_sub, he₁, he₁]
   205	
   206	set_option synthInstance.maxSize 400 in
   207	/-- Fiberwise orthonormalization of the sandwich POVM: for the placement pair
   208	exhibited by the bipartition `e`, there is, for every point pair, a projective
   209	measurement on the local space of the first placement whose placed distance to
   210	the placed sandwich is at most `220` times the fourth root of the consistency
   211	bound; on average over the point pair the distance is at most `220` times the
   212	fourth root of the averaged bound.  This is the application of `lem:ortho` in
   213	the proof of `lem:qld-4-10`, paper
   214	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:786-790`,
   215	carried out for each point pair and averaged by Jensen's inequality. -/
   216	theorem exists_projective_close_sandwich (hopp : p₁.IsOpposite p₂)
   217	    (e : SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB ≃
   218	      S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₁.side ×
   219	        (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₂.side × (PauliRegister P × PauliRegister P)))
   220	    (he₁ : ∀ O : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₁.side),
   221	      reindexOp e (heteroKron O
   222	        (1 : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₂.side ×
   223	          (PauliRegister P × PauliRegister P)))) = S.place p₁ O)
   224	    (he₂ : ∀ O : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₂.side),
   225	      reindexOp e (heteroKron (1 : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₁.side))
   226	        (heteroKron O (1 : Op (PauliRegister P × PauliRegister P)))) =
   227	          S.place p₂ O)
   228	    :
   229	    ∃ Q : PointPair P →
   230	        Measurement (PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P) (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₁.side),
   231	      (∀ xz, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (Q xz)) ∧
   232	        opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution (PointPair P))
   233	          (fun xz (ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P) =>
   234	            S.place p₁ ((Q xz).effect ab))
   235	          (fun xz ab => S.place p₁ ((S.sandwichPoint p₁.side xz.1 xz.2).effect ab))
   236	          S.psiHat ≤
   237	          220 * Real.rpow (avgOver (uniformDistribution (PointPair P))
   238	            (S.sandwichDefectBound p₁ p₂)) (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by
   239	  classical
   240	  have hψ : ‖reindexState e S.psiHat‖ = 1 := by
   241	    rw [reindexState_norm_eq, psiHat_norm]
   242	  have hxz : ∀ xz : PointPair P,
   243	      ∃ Pm : Measurement (PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P)
   244	        (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₁.side),
   245	        MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective Pm ∧
   246	          ∑ ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P, ‖applyOperatorToState
   247	            (S.place p₁ (Pm.effect ab) -
   248	              S.place p₁ ((S.sandwichPoint p₁.side xz.1 xz.2).effect ab))
   249	            S.psiHat‖ ^ 2 ≤
   250	            220 * Real.rpow (S.sandwichDefectBound p₁ p₂ xz) (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by
   251	    intro xz
   252	    have hcons : consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution Unit)
   253	        (fun _ ab => heteroKron ((S.sandwichPoint p₁.side xz.1 xz.2).effect ab) 1)
   254	        (fun _ ab => heteroKron 1
   255	          ((leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := PauliRegister P × PauliRegister P)
   256	            (S.sandwichPoint p₂.side xz.1 xz.2)).effect ab))
   257	        (reindexState e S.psiHat) ≤ S.sandwichDefectBound p₁ p₂ xz := by
   258	      rw [consistencyDefect_reindex_eq S p₁ p₂ e he₁ he₂]
   259	      exact S.sandwich_offDiagonal_le_sandwichDefectBound p₁ p₂ hopp xz
   260	    obtain ⟨Pm, hPm, hdist⟩ := projective_rounding_with_explicit_constant
   261	      (reindexState e S.psiHat) hψ (S.sandwichPoint p₁.side xz.1 xz.2)
   262	      (leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := PauliRegister P × PauliRegister P)
   263	        (S.sandwichPoint p₂.side xz.1 xz.2))
   264	      (S.sandwichDefectBound p₁ p₂ xz) (S.sandwichDefectBound_nonneg p₁ p₂ xz) hcons
   265	    refine ⟨Pm, hPm, ?_⟩
   266	    rw [opFamilyDistSq_reindex_left_eq S p₁ p₂ e he₁] at hdist
   267	    exact hdist
   268	  choose Q hQ using hxz
   269	  refine ⟨Q, fun xz => (hQ xz).1, ?_⟩
   270	  unfold opFamilyDistSq
   271	  calc avgOver (uniformDistribution (PointPair P)) (fun xz =>
   272	        ∑ ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P, ‖applyOperatorToState
   273	          (S.place p₁ ((Q xz).effect ab) -
   274	            S.place p₁ ((S.sandwichPoint p₁.side xz.1 xz.2).effect ab))
   275	          S.psiHat‖ ^ 2)
   276	      ≤ avgOver (uniformDistribution (PointPair P)) (fun xz =>
   277	          220 * Real.rpow (S.sandwichDefectBound p₁ p₂ xz) (1 / 4 : ℝ)) :=
   278	        avgOver_mono _ _ _ fun xz => (hQ xz).2
   279	    _ = 220 * avgOver (uniformDistribution (PointPair P)) (fun xz =>
   280	          Real.rpow (S.sandwichDefectBound p₁ p₂ xz) (1 / 4 : ℝ)) :=
   281	        avgOver_const_mul _ _ _
   282	    _ ≤ 220 * Real.rpow (avgOver (uniformDistribution (PointPair P))
   283	          (S.sandwichDefectBound p₁ p₂)) (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by
   284	        refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (by norm_num)
   285	        exact avgOver_rpow_quarter_le _ (uniformDistribution_weight_sum_le_one _) _
   286	          (S.sandwichDefectBound_nonneg p₁ p₂)
   287	
   288	end Bipartition

   290	/-- Fiberwise orthonormalization on Alice's side, for the placement pair
   291	`AA'`, `BA''`. -/
   292	theorem exists_projective_close_sandwich_alice (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) :
   293	    ∃ Q : PointPair P →
   294	        Measurement (PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P) (S.ExpandedLocalSpace .alice),
   295	      (∀ xz, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (Q xz)) ∧
   296	        opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution (PointPair P))
   297	          (fun xz (ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P) =>
   298	            S.place .AA' ((Q xz).effect ab))
   299	          (fun xz ab => S.place .AA' ((S.sandwichPoint .alice xz.1 xz.2).effect ab))
   300	          S.psiHat ≤
   301	          220 * Real.rpow (avgOver (uniformDistribution (PointPair P))
   302	            (S.sandwichDefectBound .AA' .BA'')) (1 / 4 : ℝ) :=

     3	/-!
     4	# Approximate commutation of the field-valued expanded point measurements
     5	
     6	The approximate commutation of `lem:qld-comm-cons` is stated for the binary
     7	refinements `M^{(Point,W),u,r}_b` of the expanded point measurements.  The
     8	combined point measurements of `lem:qld-4-10` are built here directly from the
     9	`F_q`-valued measurements `M^{(Point,W),u}_a`, so the commutation estimate is
    10	transferred to them.  The transfer is exact: since
    11	`M^{(Point,X),x}_a = E_r (-1)^{tr(ar)} X^r(x)` and
    12	`M^{(Point,Z),z}_b = E_s (-1)^{tr(bs)} Z^s(z)`, the commutator of the two
    13	measurement effects is the Fourier transform, in the outcome pair `(a, b)`,
    14	of the commutators of the expanded observables, and Parseval's identity for
    15	the additive characters of `F_q` turns the sum over `(a, b)` of the squared
    16	norms into the average over `(r, s)` of the squared norms of the observable
    17	commutators.  No factor depending on `q` is lost.
    18	
    19	## Main results
    20	
    21	* `sum_norm_sum_smul_sq_of_orthogonal`: Parseval's identity for an orthogonal
    22	  system of coefficients.
    23	* `sum_fixedCharacter_mul`: Fourier cancellation for the fixed trace character.
    24	* `expPoint_comm`: the field-valued expanded point measurements approximately
    25	  commute on every register placement, with the error of
    26	  `lem:qld-comm-cons`.
    27	
    28	## References
    29	
    30	The commutation estimate for the binary refinements is item 2 of
    31	`lem:qld-comm-cons`, blueprint
    32	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:1139-1210`, paper
    33	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:466-505`; the
    34	Fourier form of the point effects is `def:expanded-point-measurement`, paper
    35	lines 384--418.  The role of the transfer in the proof of `lem:qld-4-10` is
    36	explained in `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_linearity-theorem-quotation.tex`.
    37	-/
    38

    51	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:689-709`. -/

    55	/-! ## Parseval's identity for an orthogonal system of coefficients -/
    56	
    57	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary for `lem:qld-4-10`: if the coefficient
    58	vectors `i ↦ c j i`, `j` ranging over a finite set, are orthogonal with common
    59	squared norm `N`, then the squared norms of the weighted sums
    60	`∑ i, c j i • v i` add up to `N` times the squared norms of the `v i`. -/
    61	theorem sum_norm_sum_smul_sq_of_orthogonal {I J E : Type*} [Fintype I]
    62	    [DecidableEq I] [Fintype J] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
    63	    (c : J → I → ℂ) (N : ℝ)
    64	    (horth : ∀ i i', ∑ j, (starRingEnd ℂ) (c j i) * c j i' =
    65	      if i = i' then (N : ℂ) else 0)
    66	    (v : I → E) :
    67	    ∑ j, ‖∑ i, c j i • v i‖ ^ 2 = N * ∑ i, ‖v i‖ ^ 2 := by
    68	  have hnorm : ∀ x : E, ‖x‖ ^ 2 = (inner ℂ x x).re := fun x => by
    69	    simpa using (inner_self_eq_norm_sq (𝕜 := ℂ) x).symm
    70	  have hj : ∀ j, ‖∑ i, c j i • v i‖ ^ 2 =
    71	      (∑ i, ∑ i', ((starRingEnd ℂ) (c j i) * c j i') *
    72	        inner ℂ (v i) (v i')).re := by
    73	    intro j
    74	    rw [hnorm, sum_inner]
    75	    simp only [inner_sum, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right]
    76	    congr 1
    77	    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i' _ => ?_
    78	    ring
    79	  have hsum : ∑ j, ∑ i, ∑ i', ((starRingEnd ℂ) (c j i) * c j i') *
    80	      inner ℂ (v i) (v i') = ∑ i, (N : ℂ) * inner ℂ (v i) (v i) := by
    81	    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    82	    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    83	    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    84	    calc ∑ i', ∑ j, ((starRingEnd ℂ) (c j i) * c j i') * inner ℂ (v i) (v i')
    85	        = ∑ i', (∑ j, (starRingEnd ℂ) (c j i) * c j i') *
    86	            inner ℂ (v i) (v i') := by
    87	          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i' _ => ?_
    88	          rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    89	      _ = ∑ i', (if i = i' then (N : ℂ) else 0) * inner ℂ (v i) (v i') := by
    90	          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i' _ => ?_
    91	          rw [horth]
    92	      _ = (N : ℂ) * inner ℂ (v i) (v i) := by
    93	          simp [ite_mul]
    94	  calc ∑ j, ‖∑ i, c j i • v i‖ ^ 2
    95	      = (∑ j, ∑ i, ∑ i', ((starRingEnd ℂ) (c j i) * c j i') *
    96	          inner ℂ (v i) (v i')).re := by
    97	        rw [Complex.re_sum]
    98	        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => hj j
    99	    _ = (∑ i, (N : ℂ) * inner ℂ (v i) (v i)).re := by rw [hsum]
   100	    _ = N * ∑ i, ‖v i‖ ^ 2 := by
   101	        rw [Complex.re_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
   102	        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
   103	        rw [Complex.re_ofReal_mul, ← hnorm]

   111	/-- The phase induced by the fixed binary trace is an additive character.
   112	Paper `references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:1052-1081`. -/
   113	theorem fixedCharacter_mul (x y : PauliScalar P) :
   114	    phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model x) * phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model y) =
   115	      phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (x + y)) := by
   116	  rw [fixedBinTrace, map_add, phaseSign_eq_ffChar, phaseSign_eq_ffChar,
   117	    phaseSign_eq_ffChar]
   118	  exact ((ZMod.stdAddChar (N := 2)).map_add_eq_mul _ _).symm
   119	
   120	/-- The fixed trace character is even: negation acts trivially on the binary
   121	trace. -/
   122	theorem fixedCharacter_neg (x : PauliScalar P) :
   123	    phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (-x)) =
   124	      phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model x) := by
   125	  rw [fixedBinTrace, map_neg, ZMod.neg_eq_self_mod_two]
   126	
   127	/-- Fourier cancellation for the fixed trace character: the character sums to
   128	the field size at `0` and to zero elsewhere.  This is `lem:cancellation` for
   129	the one-dimensional space, blueprint
   130	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:686`, paper
   131	`references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:1124-1132`. -/
   132	theorem sum_fixedCharacter_mul (c : PauliScalar P) :
   133	    ∑ a : PauliScalar P, phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (a * c)) =
   134	      if c = 0 then (Fintype.card (PauliScalar P) : ℂ) else 0 := by
   135	  have h : (𝔼 r : PauliScalar P, phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (r * c))) =
   136	      if c = 0 then (1 : ℂ) else 0 := by
   137	    simpa only [fixedBinTrace, phaseSign_eq_ffChar,
   138	      MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.ffChar_apply] using
   139	      (fourier_fact_scalar (p := 2) (F := PauliScalar P) c)
   140	  rw [Finset.expect_eq_sum_div_card] at h
   141	  have hcard : (Fintype.card (PauliScalar P) : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
   142	    Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
   143	  rw [Finset.card_univ, div_eq_iff hcard] at h
   144	  rw [h]
   145	  split_ifs <;> simp
   146	
   147	/-- Orthogonality of two fixed trace characters. -/
   148	theorem sum_fixedCharacter_mul_fixedCharacter (r r' : PauliScalar P) :
   149	    ∑ a : PauliScalar P, phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (a * r)) *
   150	        phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (a * r')) =
   151	      if r = r' then (Fintype.card (PauliScalar P) : ℂ) else 0 := by
   152	  have hterm : ∀ a : PauliScalar P,
   153	      phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (a * r)) *
   154	          phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (a * r')) =
   155	        phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (a * (r' - r))) := by
   156	    intro a
   157	    rw [← fixedCharacter_neg (a * r), fixedCharacter_mul]
   158	    congr 2
   159	    ring
   160	  simp_rw [hterm, sum_fixedCharacter_mul]
   161	  by_cases h : r = r'
   162	  · simp [h]
   163	  · rw [if_neg h, if_neg]
   164	    intro h'
   165	    exact h (sub_eq_zero.mp h').symm
   166	
   167	/-- The two-dimensional character system `(a, b) ↦ χ(a r) χ(b s)` is orthogonal
   168	with common squared norm `q ^ 2`. -/
   169	theorem sum_pairCharacter_mul_pairCharacter
   170	    (rs rs' : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P) :
   171	    ∑ ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P,
   172	        (starRingEnd ℂ) (phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (ab.1 * rs.1)) *
   173	            phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (ab.2 * rs.2))) *
   174	          (phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (ab.1 * rs'.1)) *
   175	            phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (ab.2 * rs'.2))) =
   176	      if rs = rs' then
   177	        (((Fintype.card (PauliScalar P) : ℝ) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) else 0 := by
   178	  have hstar : ∀ t : ZMod 2, (starRingEnd ℂ) (phaseSign t) = phaseSign t := by
   179	    intro t
   180	    rw [← Complex.star_def]
   181	    exact star_phaseSign t
   182	  simp_rw [map_mul, hstar]
   183	  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
   184	  calc ∑ a : PauliScalar P, ∑ b : PauliScalar P,
   185	        phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (a * rs.1)) *
   186	            phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (b * rs.2)) *
   187	          (phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (a * rs'.1)) *
   188	            phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (b * rs'.2)))
   189	      = (∑ a : PauliScalar P, phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (a * rs.1)) *
   190	            phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (a * rs'.1))) *
   191	          ∑ b : PauliScalar P, phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (b * rs.2)) *
   192	            phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (b * rs'.2)) := by
   193	        rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum]
   194	        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
   195	        ring
   196	    _ = _ := by
   197	        rw [sum_fixedCharacter_mul_fixedCharacter,
   198	          sum_fixedCharacter_mul_fixedCharacter]
   199	        by_cases h1 : rs.1 = rs'.1 <;> by_cases h2 : rs.2 = rs'.2
   200	        · rw [if_pos h1, if_pos h2, if_pos (Prod.ext h1 h2)]
   201	          push_cast
   202	          ring
   203	        · rw [if_pos h1, if_neg h2, if_neg (fun h => h2 (congrArg Prod.snd h))]
   204	          simp
   205	        · rw [if_neg h1, if_pos h2, if_neg (fun h => h1 (congrArg Prod.fst h))]
   206	          simp
   207	        · rw [if_neg h1, if_neg h2, if_neg (fun h => h1 (congrArg Prod.fst h))]
   208	          simp

   214	/-- A uniform operator average is the normalized sum. -/
   215	theorem averageOperatorOverDistribution_uniform_eq_inv_card_smul_sum
   216	    {α ι : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α]
   217	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (f : α → Op ι) :
   218	    averageOperatorOverDistribution (uniformDistribution α) f =
   219	      (Fintype.card α : ℂ)⁻¹ • ∑ a, f a := by
   220	  ext i j
   221	  simp only [averageOperatorOverDistribution, uniformDistribution,
   222	    Distribution.uniformOnFinset, Finset.mem_univ, if_true, Matrix.sum_apply,
   223	    Matrix.smul_apply, Complex.real_smul, smul_eq_mul,
   224	    Finset.card_univ, one_div, Complex.ofReal_inv, Complex.ofReal_natCast]
   225	  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
